title: Hope beyond a faultless home image

captions.energy: Making ideal futures conditions of participation
captions.emotions: Feeling confidence fall after a mismatch

meaning: Your domestic support preserves hope when falling short of a dream does not cancel available help or devalue all present arrangements.
text: You may want to support one another towards a home where life becomes easier. The Star in the physical position of Muladhara embodies that hope through actions. The Star in energy, however, can make an ideal future the measure of the present: help seems sufficient only when it approaches a faultless picture. The Tower in emotions experiences a mismatch as lost confidence. Even a useful change can disappoint: it eased a specific task without providing the imagined feeling of an entirely different home.

For example, you tidy the balcony, dreaming of a quiet resting place. Sitting there is now possible, but neighbouring windows do not resemble the desired picture. All the work suddenly seems wasted. **Falling short of a dream does not cancel the value of support already created.** You can acknowledge the place’s actual limit and separately see an available opportunity to sit together; wanting something better need not become forbidden or ridiculous.

The difficulty is defending hope through a new ideal image and becoming disappointed in the present again. Support continually loses comparison with what is absent. It grows stronger when both distinguish what is desired, possible and already received. Not every idea will be realised completely, but this does not make every partial change deceptive or require abandoning present domestic life.
